indicator_name: Fixed capital investment by source of financing (own funds, republican and local budget, bank loans, other borrowed) by region, year to date
description: Инвестиции в основной капитал по источникам финансирования (собственные средства, республиканский и местный бюджет, кредиты банков, другие заёмные) по регионам, с начала года
methodology: Taldau 701827, dictionary 459 (source of financing), period 8 («месяц с накоплением»), 2018-01 onward, national and 21 regions. OWN + REP_BUDGET + LOCAL_BUDGET + BANK_LOANS + OTHER_BORROWED = TOTAL (January-September 2026: 10 587.3 + 664.7 + 1 631.7 + 893.5 + 2 304.2 = 16 081.4 bn KZT); the two «из них» items are memo lines. Budget investment (REP_BUDGET + LOCAL_BUDGET) in the January-December release is the first estimate the GDP model's manual_inputs iok_budget_private_split carried (2 936.6 / 4 098.4 / 4 984.0 bn for 2023-2025); the revised annual figures are INVESTMENT_BY_SOURCE_BY_REGION.
